Context: 1. Service Book

- SRs. 196, 197.  
- (b) It should be maintained in duplicate. First copy should be retained and maintained by the Head of the office and the second copy given to the Government servant for safe custody. In January every year, the Government servant shall hand over his copy to his office for updation, which should be returned within thirty days of its receipt. Fee for replacement of a lost copy to the Government servant is ~ 500.
- Rule 288 (1) to 288 (5) of GFR 2017.
